seoTitle: Animate Text and Add Highlight Effects in Squarespace
metaDescription: Add fade, slide, or pop-in animations to your Squarespace text to make headlines and key messages stand out to visitors.
intro: Animated text can give your Squarespace site a more dynamic, engaging feel without needing any code. This guide covers editing a text block and applying an animation style so your headlines and key messages catch a visitor's eye.

steps.heading: Log in and open your site
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, using Continue with Google if that's linked, then select the website you want to edit.

steps.heading: Enter edit mode on your page
steps.body: Locate the Edit button to enter your site's editor, then navigate to the page or post with the text you want to animate.

steps.heading: Open the text block
steps.body: Hover over the text and click the edit icon that appears to open the text editor for that block.

steps.heading: Choose an animation style
steps.body: Highlight the specific text, then select from animation options like fading in, sliding in from a direction, or appearing with a pop, previewing each before deciding.

steps.heading: Save your changes
steps.body: Click the save button to apply the animation and close the editor, then check the live page to see it in action.

faq.question: Where do I find the animation option in Squarespace?
faq.answer: After clicking edit on a text block, look for the animation icon, typically shown as a small symbol suggesting movement.

faq.question: Should I animate all my site's text?
faq.answer: No — moderation is key. Too much animation can distract visitors, so reserve it for headlines or key messages you want to highlight.

faq.question: Can I undo a text animation if I don't like it?
faq.answer: Yes, Squarespace's editor makes it easy to change or remove the animation and try a different style.

faq.question: Does animated text affect page load speed?
faq.answer: Squarespace's built-in animations are lightweight and designed to work within the platform without significant performance impact.
